configurable_props.name: groupId
configurable_props.label: Group ID
configurable_props.description: Select a Group or use a custom Group ID. You must be an Owner of this group

configurable_props.name: parent_id
configurable_props.label: Parent ID
configurable_props.description: The internal ID of a project's epic. [This feature is restricted to Gitlab's Premium and Ultimate tiers.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/epics.html)

configurable_props.name: color
configurable_props.label: Color
configurable_props.description: The color of the epic. Introduced in GitLab 14.8, behind a feature flag named `epic_highlight_color` (disabled by default)

configurable_props.name: confidential
configurable_props.label: Confidential
configurable_props.description: Whether the epic should be confidential

configurable_props.name: created_at
configurable_props.label: Created at
configurable_props.description: When the epic was created. Date time string, ISO 8601 formatted, for example `2016-03-11T03:45:40Z` . Requires administrator or project/group owner privileges (available in GitLab 13.5 and later)

configurable_props.name: start_date_is_fixed
configurable_props.label: Start Date Is Fixed
configurable_props.description: Whether start date should be sourced from start_date_fixed or from milestones (in GitLab 11.3 and later)

configurable_props.name: due_date_is_fixed
configurable_props.label: Due Date Is Fixed
configurable_props.description: Whether due date should be sourced from due_date_fixed or from milestones (in GitLab 11.3 and later)
